body.construction: Starting from the normalized primitive carrier and retained constraints, expose exactly four finite transition relations: support-licensed selector correction, reachable fixing, labelled rational elimination, and residual certificate compilation. Carry polynomial identities and branch denominators with each state; at an irreducible residual search the finite projection and signed-row-swap libraries for either an observable rational circuit or one common response-table contrast that preserves all contexts in \(H\).
